verdict.rationale: Mangopay's docs say chargeback funds are automatically deducted from the wallet. They also say the platform may be asked to settle its credit to Mangopay, which implies the platform holds liability when funds fall short. Nothing shows recovery from the seller beyond its current balance. missing for 10: automatic debits against a seller's future earnings, debits from the seller's bank account, explicit handling when a refund or chargeback exceeds the wallet balance, a documented liability order (seller vs platform vs Mangopay), refund-specific shortfall handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, refunds and chargebacks that exceed a seller's balance are recoverable — automatic debits against future earnings or their bank account, with the liability order documented

citations.quote: The funds are automatically deducted from this wallet and sent back to the user. A dispute is created which can be contested by the platform in some cases.
The platform may have the opportunity to contest the chargeback by providing proof prior to being requested to settle their credit to Mangopay.
